get.summary: List the change events for the specified element
get.description: Retrieves change events for the specified sensor or network element. Valid combinations include: Access Point only, Eye only, Access Point with Eye, Network only, or Network with Service Area

parameters.name: sensorId
parameters.description: Filter the change events for element referenced by its sensor id

parameters.name: accessPointId
parameters.description: Filter the change events for element referenced by its access point

parameters.name: networkId
parameters.description: Filter the change events for element referenced by its network

parameters.name: serviceAreaId
parameters.description: Filter the change events for element referenced by its networkId and serviceAreaId

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The time in milliseconds from the epoch from which change events are fetched (the lower bound). Defaults to the previous 24 hours.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The time in milliseconds from the epoch up to which change events are fetched (the upper bound). Defaults to the present now.
